t: This is Wardour Street, a one-way street in Soho that runs north from Leicester Square, through Chinatown, across Shaftesbury Avenue and up to Oxford Street. Throughout the twentieth century it was a centre for the British film industry and the popular music scene. The hairdresser Raymond Bessone was born here in 1911. Known as Mr Teasy-Weasy, he worked as a hairdresser from the 1930s to the 1960s, and he died in 1992.
